_doc.purpose: Localization companion for COM_furniture.json. Holds en-us entries for the wardrobe outfit change COM (com_furniture_changeOutfit). Wording matched to the com_furniture_restroom_fix siblings.

en-us.com_furniture_changeOutfit:
Can be performed when the target's current schedule (faction post or activity) calls for a different outfit. Target will change into that outfit, or back into their default clothes, on command completion.
NPC will look for a spot with a bathroom to change when needed.
